data.content:
* * *

## [Unreliable 3rd Party Shipper Employed](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a71e857f719c71d6da906e4)

They use Metropolitan Warehouse to deliver in my area. This third party shipper is notoriously bad at meeting expectations. My purchase was scheduled to be delivered 8/3 - it never arrived and they never reached out to reschedule. I have now spent nearly an hour on the phone with them trying to get a delivery date. In the meantime, the event my purchase was meant to furnish is occurring on 8/4 and we will have to move forward without the items we needed.

As of 8/13 I still have not received my order and have not received any updates about when it will arrive.

July 28, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 4, 2026

Hi Kerri,

Thank you for your feedback! Your order has arrived at the final mile hub closest to your delivery address. The White Glove Delivery is scheduled for 8/5 from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. If you have any questions or need to reschedule, please contact Metropolitan using the phone number available in the tracking link provided. We appreciate your patience!

Lulu and Georgia
